question:
In Production AI Observability and Tracing, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Root Cause'"

options.text: Desynchronized system clocks across worker nodes.
record() never accepts latency, time-to-first-token, or cost as parameters at all, so those fields are absent from every trace rather than computed incorrectly.
Spans created without a context manager fail to call finish() when an exception is raised, so they never close and accumulate in memory.
The tracer buffers spans in memory and flushes them to storage in batches, so spans from the same request can be written out of order.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Desynchronized system clocks across worker nodes.
